summary: Pickup restocks are rare and short. The last US pickup window (Oct 24) lasted about five minutes, so instant alerts matter more than timing guesses.

items.title: Store pickup briefly reopened in the US and Canada
items.summary: Pickup slots appeared for roughly five minutes around 8:10 AM ET on Oct 24; most stores showed nothing.

items.title: Restock timing is unpredictable
items.summary: Reports say store-level restocks often land between noon and 6 PM local time and sell out within minutes.

items.title: Tracker data points to late mornings
items.summary: Manzana Tracker logged 15 US restocks since Oct 16, most between 10 AM and 1 PM ET, often on Saturdays.

items.title: Delivery estimates stretch into January
items.summary: Online orders were showing delivery as late as January 2027 shortly after preorders opened.
